target.title: fix(agent-runner-memory): use truncateUtf16Safe for memory flush error truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Memory flush error helpers in agent-runner-memory truncate error messages with raw UTF-16 code-unit slices. An emoji or supplementary character crossing the 200- or 600-char boundary could leave an unpaired surrogate in user-visible error messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace two raw `.slice(0, N)` calls in `buildMemoryFlushErrorPayload` and `truncateMemoryFlushErrorMessage` with `truncateUtf16Safe`. The existing limits, prefixes, and ellipsis behavior remain unchanged.

## User Impact

Memory compaction flush error messages shown to users remain valid Unicode when long provider errors contain emoji or other supplementary characters at the truncation boundary.

## Evidence

- `npx vitest run src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.test.ts` — 1 file, 47 tests passed.

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.ts` | Replace raw `.slice(0,N)` with `truncateUtf16Safe` in two error formatting helpers. |
